result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast failure: its headline and promo-code text are white on a very pale mint background and are almost invisible. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel items and bottom card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white on a very light mint-green background, making it almost unreadable. The promo code and minimum order condition are effectively lost to users.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the pale banner, or darken the banner background to a saturated green so white text meets WCAG contrast (at least 4.5:1 for the body line).
